Ardanian Kingdoms VR

A downloadable game for Windows and Android

Ardanian Kingdoms is a medieval fantasy strategy game with indirect control - your heroes have a will of their own.

Now available on the Meta Horizons Store:
🔗 Try it here!

🏰 Place buildings, let your peasants do the work, and expand your kingdom

🧙 Heroes have free will -  they explore, rest, and fight on their own terms

🐉 Fend off monsters and powerful foes threatening your kingdom

💰 Collect taxes, manage resources, and spend wisely

⚡ Cast spells to tip the balance when your heroes need it most

🗺️ Complete handcrafted levels to expand your rule across the land

This game will always be completely free to play.

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Drop a comment or join the Ardanian Kingdoms Discord: https://discord.gg/5pJYCZyVRA

This project is a non-commercial fan tribute inspired by Majesty: The Fantasy Kingdom Sim. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Paradox Interactive. 

Cover Art and Logos: Press Kit

(🗣️ Pronounced: ar-DAY-nee-uhn Kingdoms)

Install instructions

Quest Headsets:
A: Download via Meta Quest Store: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/ardanian-kingdoms-demo/23977832438523680/
OR
B: Download the "ArdanianKingdoms.apk" file and use SideQuest to mount the .apk file onto your headset

PCVR Headsets:
-  Unzip the zip file, and run the "ArdanianKingdomsVR.exe" file, VR required

In-game Camera Menu:
- F1: Toggle the camera menu
- F2: Headset Camera View
- F3: Smooth Camera View
- F4: Free Camera Mode (Use WASD, Right Mouse Click, Shift, Ctrl to move)

Let me know in the comments if you are having any issues or require help installing.
